annotation: Replaces the design-era matrix's manual re-verify ask (its generator was deleted with the 1.x apparatus). Standard installer (skills CLI 1.5.22) run against the local RC tree; project scope in throwaway temp projects; no host config touched.

checks.name: list-discovery
checks.detail: npx skills add <local> --list finds exactly six skills: plan, qa, debug, review, ship, make-pdf; .compat aliases hidden

checks.name: full-install-byte-parity
checks.detail: --skill '*' --agent claude-code --copy: all six skills, 230/230 files sha256-identical to source

checks.name: selected-install
checks.detail: --skill qa installs only qa, 51/51 files sha256-identical

checks.name: compat-alias-opt-in
checks.detail: --skill unfreeze installs the alias ONLY with --full-depth on CLI 1.5.22 (finds 45 = 6 skills + 39 aliases); without the flag aliases stay invisible, which keeps them out of default discovery

checks.name: remove-all
checks.detail: skills remove --all -y leaves zero installed skills

checks.name: seven-host-placement
checks.detail: --skill '*' installed per host for claude-code, codex, cursor, pi, openclaw, github-copilot, kimi-code-cli: six skills each; CLI 1.5.22 places claude-code under .claude/skills, pi under .pi/skills, and consolidates the rest under the shared .agents/skills root
